remarks: Beautifully updated 2nd floor condominium in desirable Georgian Village, overlooking Patrick Henry Square. Open concept great room boasting newer flooring, integrated living, dining, and kitchen for easy modern lifestyle. Fabulous kitchen boasting shaker cabinetry, generous center island, granite counters, under-mount sink, subway tile backsplash, and full suite of upgraded S/S appliances. Both bathrooms updated with C/T surrounds, new vanities, sinks, and fixtures. New W/W in MBR. Ample closet space. Balcony off of great room, offering lots of shade. Georgian Village boasts in-ground pool for summer leisure. Basement & storage room in laundry. 1 assigned parking space, ample community parking, as well. New roof assessment fully paid. Association covers snow removal, grass cutting, master insurance, trash, water, sewer, common heating & cooling, reserves. Pets are allowed with Association permission. Just move-in and relax! Quick closing possible. No dogs allowed.
